title: Four psychic groups of ETs (friends/enemies, more/less psychic)
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Four psychic groups of ETs (friends/enemies, more/less psychic), about 1980s (study findings) at Earth and space, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The friends who are less or equal to us psychically come here for trade.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant who worked in a military program on psychic abilities in the 1980s, says he took part in a study that compared the psychic ability of humans with that of extraterrestrials, meaning beings from other worlds. According to Buchanan, the paper sorted visitors into four groups: friends or enemies, and either more or less psychic than us. He says the friends who are as psychic as us, or less, come here to trade, which would mean Earth is part of some kind of exchange with other beings.
